posts.kicker: THE BIT LIVES ON, PART TEN
posts.headline: Ten editions of torching One Nut Barner and Put it in Ra hasn't produced a single word back, and that 20-8 back-to-back-top-2 zero-ring resume is starting to look like it's allergic to pressure.
posts.detail: A .714 win pct and two straight top-2 finishes with nothing to show for it — silence on draft night just confirms this front office knows the target on their back is earned.

posts.headline: Ten straight editions of dead air from talentedtenthh and the funeral for this franchise never got un-scheduled — draft night is just the wake.
posts.detail: A dead-last 4-10 record and a 12th-place finish in year one is Browns-tier futility, and the untalented tenth still hasn't said a word to defend it.

posts.kicker: MEGAMIND FINALLY SPEAKS... WITH A ROSTER
posts.headline: Ten editions of Big Head slander later, Sasinci's World has to actually draft tonight instead of coasting on a banner, and a losing 13-15 career mark says the ring was a fluke Milk Man still can't explain.
posts.detail: One title, a 5.5 average finish, and a losing record overall — Megamind's mind is apparently too big to remember how fragile that 2025 run actually was.

posts.headline: The Thicks has now dodged five straight editions of questions, and #FreeMaxx Champions can't hide behind a ring forever when the career mark behind it is a shaky 14-14.
posts.detail: One title in two seasons with an 8th-place worst finish on the resume means the pressure to prove this wasn't a one-year mirage only grows the longer the silence continues.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh keeps getting buried edition after edition and the Prince of Persia still hasn't said a word in his own defense heading into his second draft.
posts.detail: A 5-9 record and 11th-place finish in year one earns exactly this kind of preseason disrespect, and nothing about the quiet suggests a turnaround is coming.
